motion_prompt: The presenter speaks quietly and conversationally to one person. Small precise lip movements follow every syllable, with minimal vertical jaw opening throughout both sentences. His face remains neutral and his eyebrows relaxed. The chin stays level at a constant height and the head remains centered, without nods, thrusts or emphasis beats. Both forearms stay supported by the desk, with hands relaxed during speech. Only during the silent pause between the two sentences, the right wrist makes a small slow outward turn on the desk and settles. The shoulders, camera and room remain still. Natural blinking. Finish with both hands resting and a relaxed closed mouth.
title: EP007 - Test P - Small articulation quiet head
